creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Three spellings from three reports: `.ok()`, `http_get!()`, `.or_raise()`. The bang form fights `principles.md`, and the report proposing it doesn't note the tension.

The pain is not in dispute. Thirteen or more hand-written success checks in the agent-facing corpus alone, in four different qualities of message - the catalog scripts discard `resp.error`, status and body entirely, and only `mm-thread:29-38` writes the good version. Eight near-identical "check success, pprint, red line, exit(1)" stanzas in one corpus half (`argus:70-73`, `argus2:26-29`, `argustemp:19-22`, `forex:13-16`, `fees:106-109`, `gkrelay:17-20`, `gkbsk:46-49`, `edit-liveconf:79-81`), and 12+ sites across 8 team scripts each formatting failure differently. `robodj:53` carries the author's own todo.

The periphery is consensus and already broken out into p1 cards - `timeout=`, `query=`, the Content-Type fix, `url_encode()`. Those ship regardless of how this lands.

Two more that need a home eventually: download-to-file (`upgrade:29,49` shells out to curl) and a shared client config `http_client(base=, headers=, timeout=)` - BASE_URL, TOKEN and HEADERS are duplicated across all five mattermost scripts and all seven catalog scripts.
title: Decide how http_* failures enter the error model
